name: Copy/paste HTML renderer for student projects

mentions.name: Copy/paste HTML renderer for student projects
mentions.description: This simple tool renders copy/pasted HTML so students can share and try the websites and small apps they design with ChatGPT outside of ChatGPT.
mentions.problem: The class was failing to host the websites and small apps students design with ChatGPT, and account-free public hosting is hard to provide because of spam.
mentions.audience: Students in the author's class who design websites and small apps with ChatGPT and need to share them; built by an educator for classroom use.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built a simply copy/paste HTML renderer, so they can at least share and try it outside of ChatGPT

evidence.value: I built a simply copy/paste HTML renderer, so they can at least share and try it outside of ChatGPT
